label: LINEヤフー広告 (formerly Yahoo! JAPAN Ads)
terms_note: Application registration and approval are required before API calls (スタートアップガイド: アプリケーション登録 → API呼び出し → 承認); OAuth 2.0 authorization; 'エンジニアリソースが必要'. Separate Conversion API (server-side events). Rate limits: on the reference pages (JS-only). Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (application registration + approval, then OAuth 2.0 authorization)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (LINEヤフー広告 API: Search Ads API + Display Ads API, plus Conversion API and Scripts) Confidence: **high** — official Developer Center pages read (reference pages are JS-only).
auth: 1. Register an application in the Developer Center (アプリケーション登録) and wait for approval (承認).
2. OAuth 2.0 authorization by the advertiser (or agency) account → access token + refresh token.
3. Call the service endpoints with `Authorization: Bearer`; services are POST-only JSON operations (`{Service}/get`, `/add`, `/set`, `/remove`).

endpoints.notes: campaignName, budget{amount}, campaignType, userStatus, startDate, endDate
ad{type, headline, description, finalUrl}, media (image / video)
conversionName, conversionType; offline rows (yclid, conversionDateTime, value)

reference.limits: - Rate limits on the reference (TODO(verify)); application approval required; free API; LINEヤフー for Business terms.
mcp_sdk: Official Scripts (JavaScript automation without infra); SDKs / samples on the Developer Center (TODO(verify)); no MCP found.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of your approved LINEヤフー広告 API application (API管理ツール).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from one authorization-code login with a Business ID (scope yahooads, https://ads-developers.yahoo.co.jp/ja/ads-api/startup-guide/api-call.html); valid until the user revokes the app. One-hour access tokens are minted from it.

config_fields.name: base_account_id
config_fields.help: Account the Business ID directly holds rights on (MCC or ad account id from BaseAccountService/get), sent as the x-z-base-account-id header on every call.

config_fields.name: account_id
config_fields.help: Search ad account id used by update_budget and pause_resume (CampaignService/set requires accountId in the body).

me.note: POST /BaseAccountService/get: the MCC and ad accounts the Business ID directly holds rights on.

list_accounts.note: POST /BaseAccountService/get {numberResults: 200}: accounts the Business ID directly holds rights on (MCC accounts included; raw.account.authType shows the permission). Use an id as base_account_id / account_id.

list_campaigns.note: POST /CampaignService/get {accountId, userStatuses: [status], startIndex, numberResults} with the x-z-base-account-id header. `status` is ACTIVE or PAUSED; `budget` is the daily budget (yen) of individually budgeted campaigns (shared budgets show raw.campaign.budget.campaignBudgetId). Only the first page is returned (Yahoo's startIndex is 1-based and the adapter's offset is 0-based, so it is not sent).

update_budget.note: POST /CampaignService/set {accountId (account_id config), operand: [{campaignId, budget: {amount}}]}: the daily budget in whole yen for an individually budgeted campaign (`currency` is ignored); spends money. Check operation_succeeded and errors in the result.

pause_resume.note: POST /CampaignService/set {accountId, operand: [{campaignId, userStatus: PAUSED|ACTIVE}]}. Resuming restarts spending. Check operation_succeeded.

not_offered.get_report: Search ads reports are asynchronous: ReportDefinitionService/add creates a job that is polled and then downloaded as a file (ReportDefinitionService/download, https://github.com/yahoojp-marketing/ads-search-api-documents/tree/master/design/v20/reportdefinition); the runtime has no report polling or file download.
